old_problem: A final active PCIe link does not prove the path entered the intended L1 state or substate, remained there for the required residency and woke within latency while preserving all device functions. ASPM ownership, state, iterations and policy restoration were unbound.
disposition_reason: The row unambiguously targets PCIe L1 power management through NVQual Test #30. The exact supported L1/L1.1/L1.2 state, policy owner, path capabilities, entry/residency/wake/latency oracle, iterations and recovery are runtime Project Configuration; they can gate execution without keeping the review Pending. L1 remains distinct from retrain, D3, reboot and power cycle.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2133, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2134 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00011-V002 / 0887b7403d8a2eae was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Bind the pinned Test #30 revision, complete root-port/switch/retimer/endpoint/GPU path, L1/L1SS capabilities, firmware/OS/vendor policy owner and supported target substate.

For each cycle prove initial active state, permitted idle condition, actual target-state entry, continuous residency, approved wake stimulus, measured exit latency, restored generation/width and full stable function health.
Preserve/hash preexisting logs and counters; the source instruction to clear logs cannot erase baseline or first-fault evidence.
Retain the 180-minute source coverage and signed iteration/timing rules; a short smoke cycle or final L0 snapshot is not equivalent.
Stop on missed entry, insufficient residency, wake timeout, downtraining, identity/function loss, hang/reboot, new disqualifying AER, policy drift or evidence gap; never retry automatically.
No NVQual/L1 policy change, link/device query, log clearing, reset, reboot, power cycle, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: State-residency-verified HGX NVQual Test #30 PCIe L1 power management
test_case.purpose: Prove each approved Test #30 cycle enters the specified PCIe L1 state/substate for the required residency and wakes within the approved latency with the complete NVIDIA path and functions healthy, without hang, unplanned reboot or disqualifying errors.
required_package: Pinned NVIDIA NVQual Test #30 L1 configuration with compatible firmware/driver
Signed root-port/switch/retimer/endpoint/GPU L1/L1SS capability and stable-identity map
Approved ASPM policy owner, target L1 substate, idle-entry condition, residency, wake stimulus and exit-latency oracle
Signed iterations/timing, link/device/function/error and final-policy acceptance
Dedicated idle HGX SUT, state trace/counter mapping, BMC/console and recovery runbook
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Preserve/hash baseline policies, L1/L1SS capabilities, logs, topology and inventories. Run only the pinned Test #30 state cycle; for each iteration record active start, idle condition, target L1 entry, gap-free residency, wake request, exit latency, restored generation/width, stable NVIDIA identities, function health and error deltas before the next cycle. Stop on first anomaly; do not substitute retrain, D3, reboot, power cycle or retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every configured cycle proves entry into the signed L1 state/substate, required residency and wake by deadline; the path returns at required generation/width with all expected NVIDIA identities/functions healthy, all Test #30 items accepted for the formal duration, and no hang, unplanned reboot/reset or disqualifying errors.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until the state/policy/path, residency/wake/latency oracle and iterations are approved. PASS requires every complete accepted transaction. FAIL on missed/wrong entry, insufficient residency, late/failed wake, downtraining, identity/function loss, policy mismatch, hang/reboot or disqualifying error. Missing inputs/artifacts are BLOCKED; final L0 presence cannot replace intermediate proof.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until the exact supported L1 substate, policy owner, entry/residency/wake/latency contract, iterations and recovery are signed.
Verify capability and preserve baseline policy/evidence before any power-management state change.
Use an isolated idle SUT with console and explicit 180-minute authorization.
Stop without reset/power escalation or automatic retry on first anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, owner-approved Test #30 manifest/configuration and authorization
HGX/tool/firmware/driver/BMC identities plus full path L1/L1SS capabilities and initial policy
Complete state traces or counters, AER/kernel/NVIDIA/BMC/SEL/console/thermal/power artifacts and baseline hashes
First-fault recovery or clean restored policy/link/device/host state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: At missed entry, insufficient residency, wake timeout, downtraining, identity/function loss, policy drift, hang/reboot, disqualifying error or evidence gap, inhibit later cycles and preserve the first event. Do not force another state, reset or power-cycle automatically; follow signed recovery and quarantine if expected policy/topology/health is not restored.
